AST make_constant() function doesn't make timestamp constants
If make_constant() can interpret the passed value as a timestamp, it will return a STIXdatetime object instead of a timestamp constant.  That results in an incorrect AST and messed up pattern format.  E.g.

```python
import stix2.patterns

comp_expr = stix2.patterns.EqualityComparisonExpression("a:b", "1993-07-12T22:27:23Z")
print(comp_expr)
```

results in

```
a:b = 1993-07-12 22:27:23+00:00
```

